notes.title: New Patch! Version 0.67.2
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]:

[list]
[*] Horigoshi E, Q1, Q3 range is increased by 10%
[*] Increase icon size in shop. (BenelopeRing icon is updated)
[*] Scrapanitor healing reduction 50% on auto attack
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:

[list]
[*] Smite damage not scaling
[*] Text magical gauntlet
[*] Staff Of Divinity - ManaGrowth reset mana to 0 when killed the jungle monster
[*] Camera lose focus and flinching when right click during holding left click
[*] When using target skill out of range, the character arrives then do nothing
[*] Changed "loses" to "losses"
[*] Horigoshi distortion shaders errors
[*] Horigoshi dash-q1 no mana cost
[/list]
